constructionMilestones.title: Excavation
constructionMilestones.frontDesc: Site digging and earthwork across the 22-acre parcel.
constructionMilestones.backDesc:
Context: All earthwork for Phase 1 is fully completed. Soil testing and retaining wall preparations have concluded as per the official RERA filing. Site is cleared for deep foundation work.

Target: Jan 2026 | Actual: Jan 2026

constructionMilestones.title: Foundation & Footing
constructionMilestones.frontDesc: Raft foundation and structural footing execution.
constructionMilestones.backDesc:
Context: Sub-structure works are progressing rapidly. Tower A and B foundations are complete and cured, with Tower C currently underway.

Target: Dec 2026 | Expected: Nov 2026

constructionMilestones.title: Slab Casting
constructionMilestones.backDesc:
Context: Ground and first-floor slabs have been cast for Wings A and B. Shuttering and steel reinforcement work is actively ongoing for the 2nd-floor slabs.

Target: Oct 2026 | Expected: Oct 2026

legalRiskMatrix.title: BWSSB Clearance
legalRiskMatrix.frontDesc: ₹2.75 Cr infrastructure charge for Cauvery water.
legalRiskMatrix.backDesc:
Context: BWSSB requires a ₹2.75 Cr fee for the main Cauvery pipeline connection. 

Risk Impact: Pending payment does not stall physical construction but is a mandatory prerequisite for the final Occupancy Certificate (OC) and actual water supply.

legalRiskMatrix.title: KSPCB Order
legalRiskMatrix.frontDesc: Vacation of stop-work order on Sy No. 63/6.
legalRiskMatrix.backDesc:
Context: The environmental board issued a localized stop-work order regarding buffer zone compliance specifically on Survey No. 63/6. 

Risk Impact: Currently being contested by the developer; construction on other survey numbers is proceeding normally.

legalRiskMatrix.title: KPTCL Corridor
legalRiskMatrix.frontDesc: Underground shifting of adjacent HT power lines.
legalRiskMatrix.backDesc:
Context: High-Tension (HT) lines need shifting for safety corridor clearance. 

Risk Impact: The developer has submitted the application and initial fee; currently awaiting the KPTCL execution schedule to commence the underground routing.

legalRiskMatrix.title: Title Rectification
legalRiskMatrix.frontDesc: Tracing full titles across all 6 survey numbers.
legalRiskMatrix.backDesc:
Context: RERA initially registered only Sy No. 63/2. 

Resolution: The title trace has now been legally rectified and updated on the RERA portal to include all constituent Wing A parcels (63/2, 62/5, 63/4, 63/5, 62/4, 63/3).

legalRiskMatrix.title: AAI Height NOC
legalRiskMatrix.frontDesc: Aviation clearance for maximum tower height.
legalRiskMatrix.backDesc:
Context: Initial Q4 2025 filing restricted tower heights pending Airport Authority of India (AAI) review.

Resolution: Official clearance received in Q1 2026 permitting full structural height construction up to G+18 floors without restriction.

legalRiskMatrix.title: Fire Dept Approval
legalRiskMatrix.frontDesc: Provisional NOC from State Fire & Emergency Services.
legalRiskMatrix.backDesc:
Context: Q4 2025 status showed pending approvals for fire driveways and refuge area planning.

Resolution: KSFES issued the Provisional NOC in Q1 2026, officially clearing the path for structural foundation work to commence.
